{{Top|leg}}

The '''Qulappa clan''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]]. They transported a floating fortress, which they claimed was the last surviving fortress of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]], to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]], so that visitors could view it. However, their fortress was of dubious authenticity and the historian [[Sal Ransen]] claimed that it was a fake.
